shown.message:
I rebuilt Figs. 1–5 and Tables 1–5 on the new 91-data-set results (69 NBA seasons). The new build is in `paper-repo` `dev` under `figures/out/` (commit 1ceb4b4) and pushed to my `main`. The self-test passes. Tables 1–5 compile at 5.5 in with no overfull boxes. I did not re-check the longtables after this rebuild.

- **Fig. 4B:** `matched_contrasts.csv` now exists, but it holds only the MT-Bench human vs GPT-4 (matched) contrast (n_pairs 5, n_boot 300), so panel B has two rows. I re-laid out panel B for it. A wider panel may still be needed once the Arena judge contrasts arrive, since judge names are long. I'll re-check then.
- **Table 1:** it overflowed by 15 pt once the new rows went in, so I tightened the column spacing.
- **New label:** I labelled `mtbench_gpt4_matched` as "MT-Bench GPT-4 (matched)". I couldn't find a definition of "matched" in the scripts or notes, so the caption needs `experiment-repo` to say what it means. I did not ask them.
- **Table 2 judge row:** the main-text row for the "largest-N judge" is Athene-70B only because every Arena judge has the same N. The caption should say that.

Everything is still interim. I'll rebuild each item when `experiment-repo` marks its file final. I posted the status on `figtab-repo`#2.
